title: The next pool benchmark record runs as one capped command on trustworthy measurements
goal: Before the next pool record: one benchmarks.py run pool command runs a whole record (per-arm reps and kinds, an Opus arm) under one spend cap and survives a claude -p timeout; every recorded figure is right (output tokens, the router's split-route answers, a run with no observed model) and each cell keeps its spread in benchmarks.csv; the pool rebuilds without a paid call from fact lines only and its query-log rows' checks name the article that answers; the price and alias tables cite kb lines; selfdoc check passes for the sprint's workers
